summary.text: Charlie Baum is a Republican member of the Tennessee House of Representatives for District 37, where he has served since November 2018, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In the general election, Baum is on the ballot with Mary Ann Young.

paragraphs.text: Charlie Baum was first elected to the Tennessee House of Representatives for District 37 in 2018 and took office on November 6, 2018.
In the 2023–2024 session he was vice chair of the Finance, Ways, and Means Committee and a member of the Education Administration and Pensions and Insurance committees.
